types.name: ToastProgressStatus
types.doc: `loading` shows the bar and the number; `success` and `error` are the two ways the task can end.

types.name: ToastProgressCloseReason
types.doc: Why the toast closed: the success state timed out, or the person closed it (button, Escape or swipe).

types.name: ToastProgressPosition
types.doc: `inline` renders where it is placed, like `Toast`. The others pin it to the bottom edge, like `ToastStack`.

types.name: ToastProgressProps
types.doc: A toast that follows one running task, such as an upload or an export. While it runs, a bar and a number advance; when it ends, the same toast morphs in place: the bar completes and folds away, the spinner becomes a drawn check and the copy swaps, or, on failure, the bar freezes in the danger tone and a Retry action appears. For a result that needs no progress use `Toast`; for a pending action use `ToastAction`.

members.name: title
members.doc: What is running, or how it ended. Pass the text for the current status; the copy swaps in place when it changes.

members.name: description
members.doc: Optional second line. While the task runs it may change on every tick (for example "27 of 42 MB") without replaying the swap.

members.name: value
members.doc: How far the task is, from 0 to 100. The bar and the number glide to each new value.

members.name: status
members.doc: State of the task. Left out, the toast runs until `value` reaches 100 and then shows success.

members.name: icon
members.doc: Glyph in the status circle while the task runs. A spinner by default.

members.name: formatValue
members.doc: Text beside the title while the task runs. Receives the rounded value that is on screen; by default it prints a percentage such as "64%".

members.name: retryLabel
members.doc: Label of the action shown when the task fails.

members.name: onRetry
members.doc: Runs when Retry is pressed. Without it the failed state has no action. Set `status` back to `"loading"` to resume.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the toast starts showing when `open` is not passed.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called when the toast closes itself, with the reason: `"timeout"` or `"dismiss"`.

members.name: duration
members.doc: Milliseconds the success state stays before the toast closes itself. Pass 0 or Infinity to keep it. A running or failed task never closes by itself.

members.name: position
members.doc: Where the toast sits. `inline` stays in the flow; the bottom positions pin it to the window.

members.name: contained
members.doc: With a bottom position, pins the toast inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the window, for panels and previews.

members.name: hotkey
members.doc: Alt+T moves focus into the toast (to Retry when it is showing).

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the toast surface.
